intro: Sexy Fish Miami is the glamorous, high-energy Japanese seafood restaurant and lounge in Brickell, part of the London-born Sexy Fish brand, known as much for its over-the-top decor and cocktails as its food. The menu is modern Japanese: sushi and sashimi, robata-grilled dishes, seafood towers and signature plates, with a famous bar. Below is a guide to the Sexy Fish Miami menu for 2026.
quick_answer: Sexy Fish Miami is an ultra-upscale ($$$$) Japanese seafood restaurant and lounge in Brickell. The menu covers sushi and sashimi, robata-grilled dishes, and seafood towers like the Sexy Fruits De Mer (about $70 per person), with dishes such as the Caramelized Black Cod (around $50) and cocktails around $25 each. It is a special-occasion, reservation-based 'clubstaurant,' so prices are high and it does not publish a fixed price list.
hot_deal: Sexy Fish Miami value: this is a special-occasion, high-end spot rather than a value restaurant, so the cheapest way to experience it is the bar and cocktails, or the 'Sexy Fish by Day' lunch set where offered, instead of a full dinner with a seafood tower. Reservations are strongly recommended. Prices are set at the restaurant and not published as a fixed list.

faqs.q: What kind of restaurant is Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: Sexy Fish Miami is an ultra-upscale Japanese seafood restaurant and lounge in Brickell, part of the London-born Sexy Fish brand. It is a glamorous, high-energy 'clubstaurant' known for its dramatic decor, cocktails and modern Japanese menu of sushi, robata and seafood towers.

faqs.q: How much does Sexy Fish Miami cost?
faqs.a: It is a very high-end ($$$$) restaurant. A seafood tower like the Sexy Fruits De Mer runs about $70 per person, the Caramelized Black Cod around $50, and cocktails about $25 each. It does not publish a fixed price list, so a full dinner with drinks is a special-occasion bill.

faqs.q: What is Sexy Fish Miami known for?
faqs.a: It is known for its over-the-top decor and bar scene as much as its food, with signature dishes like the Sexy Fruits De Mer seafood tower, the Caramelized Black Cod, and wagyu gyoza. The cocktails are often singled out as the highlight.

faqs.q: Do I need a reservation for Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: A reservation is strongly recommended, as it is a popular, high-energy upscale venue, especially on weekend nights. Booking ahead through the restaurant or a reservation service is the safest way to get a table.

faqs.q: What are the most popular dishes at Sexy Fish Miami?
faqs.a: Favorites include the Sexy Fruits De Mer seafood tower, the Caramelized Black Cod, the wagyu gyoza, the signature sushi rolls, and the cocktails.
